title: epan: Fake nodes with null field_info to ensure proper tree structure
description:
Faking nodes by returning the parent node has the problem of
producing an inaccurate tree structure. This isn't a problem
when initially adding nodes, but makes it impossible to later
change the length of the parent node. proto_item_set_len cannot
determine if the passed in node parameter contains the actual
field whose length should be changed, or if it contains a
parent node because the field was faked (in which case the call
should be ignored.)

Similarly, other routines that examine the tree structure, like
proto_item_get_parent, don't work properly on non-visible trees.

Deal with the problem by creating tree nodes with null field_info
structures and returning those. That should continue to have the
optimization benefits but avoid producing an incorrect structure.

The API functions generally deal with null field_info in a node
correctly, but dissectors and taps that examine the protocol tree
directly may not.

Add a hfinfo member to the node with the const header_field_info,
which exists and is known even when the node is faked.

Remove the MATE workaround of making the tree always visible. Now
that #17877 is fixed, #19619 works without this.

Fix #17877. Fix #18503.

added 10 commits
  • 987fc00e...850b1659 - 9 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 51e0dfa0 - epan: Fake nodes with null field_info to ensure proper tree structure
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17931/diffs?diff_id=1172972144&start_sha=987fc00e53f6ffbc636b32c934631abb3629a2af)

```
wireshark$ git bisect bad
51e0dfa0057783b52d3b7e00cd4af1395b96b630 is the first bad commit
commit 51e0dfa0057783b52d3b7e00cd4af1395b96b630
```
[241121_pcapng_file_menu_example.lua](/uploads/e1bf4b74c365570608100ee3418652c7/241121_pcapng_file_menu_example.lua)  
  
Prior to this commit, this tap syntax worked to return "field.display":  
`local tap = Listener.new();`  
  

```
3271:	0x00000216: (Sysdig Event Block v2)
1:	0x00000219: (Sysdig Interface List Block version 2)
1:	0x00000220: (Sysdig User List Block version 2)
238:	0x00000218: (Sysdig File Descriptor List Block)
1:	0x00000201: (Sysdig Machine Info Block)
1:	0x0a0d0d0a: (Section Header Block)
1:	0x00000215: (Sysdig Process List Block version 9)
```

After the commit the same code just gets the values:  

```
1:	0x0a0d0d0a
1:	0x00000201
1:	0x00000219
238:	0x00000218
3271:	0x00000216
1:	0x00000215
1:	0x00000220
```

Changing the Listener code to `local tap = Listener.new(nil,nil,true)` returns the "field.display" strings.  
  
Is this expected?  
If so, how/where to document - Release Notes? Lua section of WSDG?

For me, on 4.4.2, the sample does the same thing of having only the values - I believe that's because I *don't* have a MATE configuration, and you do, and MATE previously was always setting the entire tree to be visible, which is the same thing as that `true` does in the last parameter of `Listener.new()`

Note also that

`local tap = Listener.new(nil,"pcapng.block.type")` will work (and is faster than generating all the fields.)

Thanks! I didn’t make the connection with MATE. Having the dissector
disabled is not enough to not have it impact.
Will try the filter string with Listener also.
